name: Far Vision
definition: The ability to see details at a distance.

benchmark.name: TinyPerson
benchmark.model_or_system: Faster R-CNN-FPN with Scale Match (RSM) COCO pretraining, ResNet-50
benchmark.metric: AP50-tiny (%) on the TinyPerson test set
benchmark.human_reference: General working adults with normal or corrected vision whose jobs rely on spotting distant people or objects in wide scenes, such as lifeguards, security or surveillance operators, and drivers. They are assumed to inspect the same images carefully, not under a severe time limit.

benchmark.name: TinyPerson
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant workforce that visually searches wide scenes for small, distant people: lifeguards, surveillance/CCTV operators, search-and-rescue spotters, UAV imagery analysts, working from the same high-resolution images.

benchmark.name: VisDrone
benchmark.model_or_system: VisDrone-DET2021 challenge first-place entry (the source does not name the team)
benchmark.metric: AP (%), averaged over IoU thresholds 0.50:0.95, on the VisDrone-DET test-challenge set
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: image analysts and drone or surveillance operators who inspect aerial imagery to find and classify vehicles and people. The broader proxy is sighted working adults using far vision.

benchmark.name: TinyPerson
benchmark.metric: mAP_tiny (%), meaning AP at IoU 0.5 on the tiny [2,20] px interval under the TinyPerson protocol
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce with normal or corrected vision who do visual search at a distance (e.g., lifeguards, security and surveillance observers, spotters), inspecting the same high-resolution images

benchmark.name: V* Bench
benchmark.human_reference: General adult with normal or corrected vision, viewing the full-resolution image with the ability to scan and zoom. This matches how the benchmark stands in for far vision in everyday work, where people pick out small distant objects and read their attributes.

benchmark.name: HR-Bench
benchmark.metric: accuracy (%), HR-Bench 8K overall (average of FSP and FCP)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce with normal or corrected vision, inspecting the same 8K images on a display with ordinary pan/zoom and no time pressure.

benchmark.name: HR-Bench
benchmark.model_or_system: SCCM-based RFT model (built on a Pixel-Reasoner baseline)
benchmark.metric: accuracy (%), HR-Bench 8K overall (average of FSP and FCP)
benchmark.human_reference: General working adults with normal or corrected vision who inspect fine details in large high-resolution imagery (e.g., inspectors, analysts, general visual work)
